image_description: The image displays a group of four Nile crocodiles basking on a rocky bank next to a body of water, surrounded by lush tropical vegetation including palm trees. The crocodiles are arranged in a line, with the closest one fully visible and the others receding into the background. They exhibit the characteristic armored dorsal surface and low-slung posture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head of the foreground crocodile is clearly visible, showing the broad, triangular shape and V-shaped snout typical of crocodiles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouths of the crocodiles are closed, and the resolution/angle does not allow for the verification of specific tooth interlocking or the visibility of the fourth lower tooth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the eyes are visible on the top of the head, the image resolution is insufficient to discern vertical slit pupils or the transparent nictitating membrane.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostrils are clearly visible at the very end of the snout on the foreground subject.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All subjects display the characteristic elongated body shape covered in heavy armor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal surface shows distinct, raised scutes arranged in longitudinal rows, consistent with the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-brown, and the texture appears rough and bony.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crocodiles are lying on their bellies; the ventral surface is completely occluded by the ground and their own bodies.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are tucked under the body or obscured by the angle and vegetation. Digit counting is impossible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tails are visible, appearing muscular and laterally compressed, extending significantly behind the body.
